content.short: BlockSec Phalcon is a hack monitoring and blocking platform for post-launch DeFi protocol security.
content.description: Phalcon is a security platform that continuously monitors DeFi protocols to detect and block exploits after launch. It identifies suspicious transactions, issues immediate alerts, and can perform automated responses to mitigate threats. Its core strengths include precise detection with minimal to zero false positives, monitoring of hacks and operational risks like privilege changes, and a code-free interface for configuring monitors and automated actions. The platform provides a transparent, trustworthy SaaS experience for ongoing security and risk management in blockchain ecosystems.

resources.title: Blocking the ParaSpace Attack and Rescuing $5M
resources.tldr: An attack detected and stopped mid-flight rather than analysed afterwards. The response window was minutes, which is the whole case for live monitoring.

resources.title: Counter-Exploiting an Attacker's Contract: The Platypus Case
resources.tldr: Turning the attacker's own contract against them to recover funds. Legally and ethically contested, technically fascinating, and documented here in full.

resources.title: Hacking Back to Rescue Funds in the Transit Swap Attack
resources.tldr: Another live intervention, smaller in value but the same pattern. Read alongside the others it shows what defenders can actually do mid-incident.
